strings.landing.hero.eyebrow: A programme of the AGI Future Foundation
strings.landing.hero.title: Train the trades like the next century depends on them.
strings.landing.hero.lede: Because it does. The people who wire the grid, weld the pressure vessels, rig the loads and run the plant are the ones who will physically build whatever comes next — and they are being trained on a model designed for the last industrial revolution.
strings.landing.hero.lede2: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy is an adaptive training system for 111 trade unions: a virtual city of job sites where every task is set at the edge of what you can already do, every coaching decision explains itself, and a ticket is issued only when you have demonstrated the work unaided.
strings.landing.facts.halls: union halls, each with a floor plan and 100 levels
strings.landing.facts.modules: module IDs, every one verified unique
strings.landing.facts.band: the success band every task is dialled into
strings.landing.facts.defects: protocol defects found and fixed before any learner saw them
strings.landing.mission.h2: Skilled work is not a fallback. It is the foundation.
strings.landing.mission.p1: For two generations, trades training has been treated as the path for people who did not take the other one. That framing was always wrong, and it is about to become expensive. Data centres need electricians. Electrification needs line workers. Every climate commitment on earth is a promise about pipefitters, ironworkers and insulators who do not exist yet.
strings.landing.mission.p2: The AGI Future Foundation builds public-interest education infrastructure. Trade Craft Academy is its answer to a specific question: if intelligent systems can now teach, what should they teach first? Our answer is the work that cannot be automated away and cannot be learned from a video — skilled physical craft, taught to mastery, at a scale no apprenticeship system has ever reached.
strings.landing.mission.tick1: Never boredom, never anxiety. Difficulty is throttled to the edge of current capability, continuously, per skill.
strings.landing.mission.tick2: Every decision explains itself. A learner can ask why they were given any task and get the real reason, from the same record an auditor reads.
strings.landing.mission.tick3: A ticket means something. Certification requires demonstrated, unaided work at gate difficulty. Help cannot buy it.
strings.landing.mission.tick4: The system answers to people. Instructors override it, learners can ask for an easier day, and it stops adapting entirely rather than adapt badly.
strings.landing.how.p: Most “adaptive” learning is a fixed sequence with a difficulty knob bolted on. This is a control system. It estimates what you can do, serves work just inside that edge, and proves the estimate before it certifies anything.
strings.landing.how.dial.p: A learner profile turns telemetry — accuracy, hesitation, help requests, control smoothness in the sim — into a proficiency estimate, and a closed-loop controller holds predicted success inside 0.70–0.85. Above the band is boredom; below it is anxiety. Both are failures, and both get corrected within a handful of tasks.
strings.landing.how.graph.p: Skills are a graph, not a list. Evidence on one skill moves its prerequisites, confusable pairs are kept apart, and what you learned in March comes back for review before you lose it. When someone is stuck, the system diagnoses which prerequisite is missing rather than repeating the same task harder.
strings.landing.how.gate.p: Practice runs at the middle of the band, where learning happens. Certification runs at the top of it, unaided, with hints closed — a deliberate verification run, because practice difficulty can never prove mastery. Certification is an awarded event on an append-only record.
strings.landing.how.coaches.p: Every hall has a mentor agent that knows its trade. They coach, explain and escalate to a human instructor when something is wrong on site. What they cannot do is change your difficulty, your record or your certification — that is enforced in code, not asked for in a prompt.
strings.landing.investors.p1: The workforce gap in skilled trades is not a marketing thesis; it is an arithmetic one. Retirements are outrunning apprenticeship intake in every industrialised economy, and the constraint on electrification and reindustrialisation is people, not capital.
strings.landing.investors.p2: What we have built is the part that is hard to build: a validated curriculum ledger, an adaptive control system that has been calibrated against simulation and hardened against long-run and adversarial failure, an agent layer whose safety properties are enforced rather than promised, and a security model designed for multi-tenant institutional customers.
strings.landing.investors.p3: What we have not built is a business with revenue. We are pre-launch, pre-pilot and pre-accreditation, and we would rather you learn that here than in diligence.
strings.landing.investors.term.content.dd: Authored lesson content across 33 trades, reviewed by journey-level practitioners. The largest single line, and the one that cannot be shortcut.
strings.landing.investors.term.evidence.dd: A stepped-wedge evaluation with real apprentices. Until that runs, our efficacy claims are simulation results and we will say so.
strings.landing.investors.term.compliance.dd: SOC 2 observation window, accessibility audit and VPAT, jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction review before any certification claim.
strings.landing.investors.term.platform.dd: Identity, persistence, encryption and the operational layer a public launch requires.
strings.landing.partners.h2: Unions, employers, and the people who own the job sites.
strings.landing.partners.p: This platform is worth nothing without the trades themselves. We are not trying to replace an apprenticeship — we are trying to give it instrumentation, reach, and a way to put a first-year apprentice in a confined space, a live panel or a crane cab a hundred times before it counts.
strings.landing.partners.panel.unions.p: Your training directors own the content for your trade — the standards, the sequence, the sign-off. We provide the engine, the sim, and the evidence trail. Your ticket stays yours; we do not issue credentials in your name and never will.
strings.landing.partners.panel.employers.p: Rehearse a specific site before anyone sets foot on it — induction, permit conditions, hazard walk, the actual plant. Cross-trade hand-offs, where most incidents start, get practised as a named skill with its own assessment.
strings.landing.partners.panel.tech.p: Everything emits xAPI 1.0.3 to your LRS. The module catalogue exports as JSON or CSV. The agent layer registers on open agent protocols. We would rather integrate with your system of record than become one.
strings.landing.educators.h2: You keep the judgement. It keeps the bookkeeping.
strings.landing.educators.p: An adaptive system should make an instructor more powerful, not redundant. Ours is built so that the decisions requiring judgement stay with you and the decisions requiring memory stay with it — who is stuck and on what, who is overdue for review, who is ready to be tested, and who has been quietly leaning on help for three weeks.
strings.landing.educators.tick1: You can always override. Pin any learner to any level. The override is logged, and the system down-weights that evidence because it knows it is no longer a clean measurement.
strings.landing.educators.tick2: You see the reasoning. Every task served carries the reason it was chosen. If you disagree with the system, you can see exactly what it believed and why.
strings.landing.educators.tick3: Fairness is monitored, not asserted. Outcomes are compared across sites, languages, device types and age bands. A gap above 10% opens a ticket and blocks releases — and quietly tuning one cohort's settings to make the gap disappear is itself flagged.
strings.landing.educators.tick4: It stops rather than guess. If calibration drifts or a cohort is struggling, adaptation halts and everyone gets fixed difficulty until a human has looked.
strings.landing.educators.panel.p1: Training records are held under a pseudonym; the link to a person lives in a separate service that no standing role can read. Erasure breaks that link, which is what makes it real rather than cosmetic.
strings.landing.educators.panel.p2: Emotional-state signals — the flow and frustration estimates the dial uses — are the most protected data we hold, not the least. They are kept for 90 days, are never included in any export, and are never visible to an employer.
strings.landing.status.h2: What is built, what is not, and what we will not claim.
strings.landing.status.p: Education technology has a credibility problem because it routinely describes intentions in the present tense. Here is the actual state, and the same table goes to every investor, partner and institution that asks.
strings.landing.status.row1.detail: Calibrated in simulation; holds the target band roughly 6× better than fixed or random difficulty across six learner archetypes.
strings.landing.status.row2.detail: 11,000,000 module IDs generated from 25,875 authored objects, every one proved unique across the whole population — not a sample.
strings.landing.status.row3.detail: Coaching agents cannot write control state; enforced at two independent layers and verified against deliberately misbehaving agents.
strings.landing.status.row4.detail: Tenant isolation, deny-by-default permissions, time-boxed identity access, per-class retention and erasure.
strings.landing.status.row5.detail: The 11,000,000 figure counts addressable module IDs, not hand-written lessons. Structure, sequencing and assessment logic are real and verified; the catalogue is generated from 25,875 authored objects, and the lesson prose awaits authoring by journey-level practitioners.
strings.landing.status.row6.detail: The 111 halls are our taxonomy of skilled trades. They are not chartered locals, no union has reviewed the list, and the grouping into districts is ours.
strings.landing.status.row7.detail: All results to date are simulation. No claim about learning outcomes is supported until the stepped-wedge trial with real apprentices runs.
strings.landing.status.row8.detail: We hold no accreditation and no union has endorsed this platform. Nothing here confers a recognised credential.
strings.landing.status.row9.detail: Authentication, encryption, persistence, backups and incident response are required before public launch and do not yet exist.
strings.landing.status.note: Seventeen protocol defects have been found and fixed by simulation, long-run soak and adversarial testing — including a certification path that could never actually certify anyone, a single malformed event that could permanently corrupt a learner's record, and a help-fading rule that was specified, believed to be in force, and had never once run. The list includes the ones we found in our own checks, such as a layout assertion built on a guessed constant that was 43% wrong and passed while four labels overflowed. We publish the list because a system that has never found a fault in itself has not looked.
strings.landing.footer.disclaimer: Please read this part. Nothing on this page is a recognised credential, an accreditation, or an endorsement by any trade union or licensing body. Training content is general good practice and has not been verified against any jurisdiction's code. Safety-critical work must be learned and signed off by qualified people on real sites.

strings.map.titleblock.title: Network Plan · Union Halls
strings.map.footer.p1: Every number on this plan is read from the module registry — hall counts, module counts and pipeline states are the pack's own values, not illustrations. The geography is schematic: bands show how the halls are grouped, not surveyed positions.
strings.map.footer.p2: The interiors are functional programmes, not surveys. Each hall's rooms come from the eleven skill strands that hall actually teaches, and a room gains trade fixtures only when that trade's own focus line names them — a welding hall gets booths and fume extraction because its skills say so, and a drywall hall does not. No address data has been collected for any hall, so every plan carries an empty site block rather than an invented street address. The commissioning state on each plan is read from that hall's live-module share.
strings.map.footer.p3: This is a plan of the network's halls grouped by district, not one campus site — each district band names the built campus it belongs to. Nothing on this plan is an accreditation or a union endorsement, and lesson content is unverified general practice pending authoring by practitioners.

strings.resto.title: Bay restoration training scenarios
strings.resto.play: Training scenario, not the project's actual work plan. Lessons are unverified general practice; a run is practice and never enters a completion record.
strings.deep.honesty: Underwater depths, seabed and habitats (eelgrass, oyster reef, mudflat, riprap) are AUTHORED: no real bathymetry is held, so this is not a chart. Dive and ROV are a game camera for monitoring practice, not dive training. Animals are never harmed. Keys: R up, F down; ROV: I/K forward/back, J/L turn.
strings.deep.hud.heading: heading
strings.deep.refused: Swim in deep water first (or stand by water for the ROV).
strings.tqkit.done: All four steps done: hand-off made.
strings.tqkit.note: Play only: this station never enters a completion record and certifies nothing.
strings.tqkit.authored: AUTHORED training mock-up, not real equipment
strings.tqkit.electrical.title: Electrical panel: observe and hand off
strings.tqkit.electrical.s1: Read the supplied panel label and circuit directory.
strings.tqkit.electrical.s2: Mark the work zone in front of the panel.
strings.tqkit.electrical.s3: Pick an approved training tool from the tray.
strings.tqkit.electrical.s4: Stop at the tagged panel and hand off to your supervisor.
strings.tqkit.plumbing.title: Water heater and sink trap: observe and hand off
strings.tqkit.plumbing.s1: Read the water heater's supplied evidence label.
strings.tqkit.plumbing.s2: Mark the zone around the leak and the puddle.
strings.tqkit.plumbing.s3: Pick an approved training tool from the tray.
strings.tqkit.plumbing.s4: Stop at the tagged supply and hand off to your supervisor.
strings.tqkit.hvac.title: Rooftop unit: observe and hand off
strings.tqkit.hvac.s1: Read the service card on the disconnect.
strings.tqkit.hvac.s2: Mark the roof safety zone around the unit.
strings.tqkit.hvac.s3: Pick an observation-only tool from the tray.
strings.tqkit.hvac.s4: Stop at the locked and tagged disconnect and hand off.
strings.tqkit.carpentry.title: Stud wall and bench: observe and hand off
strings.tqkit.carpentry.s1: Read the layout card for the stud wall.
strings.tqkit.carpentry.s2: Mark the work zone around the bench.
strings.tqkit.carpentry.s3: Pick the tape measure from the tray.
strings.tqkit.carpentry.s4: Stop at the tagged power tool and hand off to your supervisor.
strings.campus3d.siteplan: Site plan and hall styles AUTHORED: each hall is its own building at the size you walk inside - not real buildings, lots or addresses
strings.campusplan.legend: Site plan: AUTHORED. Each hall stands on its own lot at the size of its walkable interior; no real site, parcel, address or survey is shown.
strings.fleet.hud.exit: F or Get out leaves the vehicle
strings.fleet.drive.refused: No spot for this vehicle within reach: land vehicles stay on ground, boats stay on water.
strings.fleet.drive.noland: No dry ground beside the vehicle: stay aboard and steer to the shore.
strings.fleet.drive.honesty: Driving is play with SCHEMATIC arcade physics: handling classes are AUTHORED from the fleet registry figures, not any vehicle's real handling.
strings.packs.honest.robotics: Robotics environments are AUTHORED specs with SCRIPTED reference policies. No model has been trained on them, and the repository records no training run.
strings.packs.honest.tq: TradesQuest field-job stations are AUTHORED mock-ups ported from TradesQuest, a separate product of the same organisation; they are play and never a completion record.
strings.packs.honest.colour: Patterns and colours are AUTHORED: no paint brand, trademarked colour name or official value of a standard.
strings.pattern.title: Materials & colour
strings.pattern.lede: Exterior pattern recipes and colour categories. Every preview is drawn in your browser from parameters; no image file is shipped.
strings.pattern.previews: Pattern previews (2 x 2 tiles, so you can see the seams wrap)
strings.pattern.provenance: AUTHORED: every recipe and colour was chosen by eye for this build - no photograph, supplier swatch, paint brand or standard colour value.
strings.pattern.cvd: Checked at build time: every text pair shown reaches WCAG AA 4.5:1, and every two colours in one category stay at least CIE76 dE {de} apart under simulated protanopia and deuteranopia (Machado 2009).
strings.robo.title: Robotics lab
strings.robo.lede: Environment specs built from the simulators and worlds in this bundle, three authored robots you can drive, and a recorder that keeps a demonstration only when you ask. No model has been trained on any of it.
strings.robo.seo.desc: Robotics lab: gym-style environment specs, authored robot embodiments, teleoperation and opt-in, device-local demonstration recording. Nothing has been trained.
strings.robo.s.robokit: world envs you can drive here
strings.robo.h.how: How a learner records a demonstration
strings.robo.h.trained: What is and is not trained
strings.robo.refrun.note: Computed in your browser now from the same deterministic core the test suite runs. Successful runs:
strings.robo.how.1: Pick an environment and a seed; the arena is laid out the same way for that seed every time.
strings.robo.how.2: Press Record. Nothing is kept unless you do, and nothing is kept if the training recorder is switched off.
strings.robo.how.3: Drive with W A S D or the arrow keys, or the on-screen pad on a phone. The pose, speed, nearby object ids and your inputs are sampled five times a second.
strings.robo.how.4: When the task ends (or you press Stop) the episode is kept in this browser only, beside your other training episodes.
strings.robo.how.5: Run the reference policy on the same seed to compare, export the file, and share it only if you choose, from the Contribute page.
strings.robo.is.1: Is: environment specs with units, ranges, reward terms and termination, read from this bundle’s registries.
strings.robo.is.2: Is: a scripted reference policy - hand-written, deterministic and seeded, with no model and no network behind it.
strings.robo.is.3: Is: demonstration episodes you choose to record, in this browser, in a documented shape.
strings.robo.not.1: Not: a trained model. No model has been trained on these environments or episodes, and none is claimed.
strings.robo.not.2: Not: a real robot. The robots and arenas are authored and the motion is schematic.
strings.robo.not.3: Not: an upload. Nothing leaves this browser unless you export a file; classroom mode offers no recording.
strings.robo.compare: You vs the reference policy (same seed)
strings.robo.kept: Kept in this browser - world episodes this visit:
strings.robo.honesty: Authored robot and arena, schematic motion, scripted reference policy. Nothing here trains a model; episodes stay in this browser unless you export them.
strings.robo.classroom: Classroom mode: recording and export are not offered.
strings.robo.off: Not kept: the training recorder is off or this browser blocks storage.
strings.robo.hint: Click the arena, then drive: W A S D or arrows; G or Space grips (arm); R and F change depth (ROV).
strings.packs.honest.data: Sharing data is opt-in per package and stays on the device until the learner exports a file. No upload is live, no model has been trained on shared data, and classroom (K-12) mode offers no sharing.
strings.fleet.hud.exit_e: E or Get out leaves the vehicle
strings.datashare.title: Share data
strings.datashare.lede: Keep your episodes on this device, choose each package to share, and check what the data covers before anyone trains on it.
strings.datashare.classroom: K-12 / classroom mode: data sharing is not offered here. Nothing is stored, exported or analysed for sharing in this mode.
strings.fields.lede: Regional seasonal tasks on AUTHORED game plots: pick a plot and something in season, then do each step inside its window.
strings.fields.early: Too early - wait for the window to open.
strings.fields.late: The window closed - the task starts again from its first step.
strings.fields.off_season: Not in season this month in the game calendar.
strings.fields.nostore: Progress will not be saved on this device.
strings.fields.play: Every harvest and log entry is play: kept on this device only, never a completion record, never money.
strings.fish.title: Fishing and crawfish
strings.fish.lede: Walk to a marked spot on the water, pick a rod or trap and a bait, then cast, wait for the bite and reel with the line tension in the green.
strings.fish.near_none: No fishing spot in the loaded area yet.
strings.fish.walk_to: Walk to a spot marker to fish.
strings.fish.aim: Hold to aim and power, let go to cast
strings.fish.bite: Bite! Hold Reel and keep the tension in the green.
strings.fish.nobite: No bite. Try another bait, time of day, month or spot.
strings.fish.trap_empty: The trap came up empty - try another month or spot.
strings.fish.play: Every catch is play, stored only on this device: never a completion record, never money, never a licence.
strings.fish.wrong_gear: This rod does not suit this water.
strings.fish.season_note: Seasons here are approximate, game calendar.
strings.fish.keys: Keys: Space or Enter holds to aim and reel, arrows aim, R releases, K keeps in log.
strings.smiles.title: Unspoken Smiles world
strings.smiles.lede: Walk a made-up neighbourhood around a dental clinic: open the clinic rooms to reach the training stations, then play brushing, flossing, snack, plaque, handwashing and drinks games and hunt for hidden tooth-fairy eggs.
strings.smiles.seo.desc: An AUTHORED walkable district with a dental clinic, school, park and playground: hygiene games, hidden eggs and links to the Unspoken Smiles clinic stations.
strings.smiles.authored: A made-up district drawn for this game - not a real place, not surveyed.
strings.smiles.play: Games, eggs and badges are play: kept on this device only, never a completion record, never money.
strings.smiles.walk: Walk with the arrow keys, WASD or the pad
strings.smiles.map.alt: AUTHORED map of the Unspoken Smiles district: clinic, school, park, playground, community centre, shop, van lot and garden
strings.smiles.nowebgl: 3D is not available in this browser; the games, rooms and map below still work.
strings.smiles.more: Which one usually has more added sugar?
strings.smiles.disclaimer: General guidance, not medical or dental advice.
strings.smiles.floss.next: Clean each gap in order, starting at 1.
strings.wild.title: Wildlife watch
strings.wild.play: Play only - kept on this device.
strings.wild.none: No wildlife in view. Keep exploring near water and green space.
strings.wild.too_far: Too far for a photo - move a little closer, slowly.
strings.wild.nest_note: Classroom mode: the alligator season is replaced by a nest survey - count and photograph from a distance.
strings.wild.off_season: Outside the game season - you can still practise the steps
strings.veg.honesty: Trees, plants and street details: AUTHORED placement of generally named regional plants and generic street furniture (rules by land use and distance to water) - not a tree survey, species map or count.
strings.elev.legend.authored: relief: AUTHORED - procedural knolls in park districts and levee banks beside AUTHORED channels, a few metres at most; no real elevation is held for this world.
